Title: Connect to your virtual machine (VM) through a web browser

Body.Content:
Azure DevTest Labs now integrates with Azure Bastion, enabling you to connect to your virtual machines through a web browser. Azure Bastion provides secure and seamless RDP/SSH connectivity to your virtual machines directly in the Azure portal over SSL.

As a lab owner, it’s possible to enable your lab virtual machines to have browser-based access provided they’re created in a virtual network that has Azure Bastion configured on it.

Submit your feedback and ideas, or vote for others at the Azure DevTest Labs forum. If you have questions, read answers or ask a new one at our MSDN forum.
